component.name: Fancontrol-GUI
component.summary: GUI frontend for the fancontrol script

description.p: Fancontrol-GUI is a graphical user interface for the fancontrol script. It lets you monitor temperatures and fan speeds, tune the fan curve for each PWM fan, test start and stop values, and manage profiles for different scenarios.

The application integrates with the desktop through a system tray icon, sends desktop notifications when a temperature crosses a configurable threshold, and can control the fancontrol systemd service directly from the interface.
Repaint chart canvases when the system colour scheme changes, so the fan-curve plot and history graphs no longer keep their dark colours after switching to light mode.

Qt6/KF6 release: tabbed Fans layout with an editable fan curve and presets, an autotune rework with live feedback, editable fan names, full profile management, a structured Configfile view with validation and diffing, live system light/dark following, and installable DEB/RPM packages.
